parameters.description: Workspace ID for routing and authorization.
parameters.name: workspaceId

parameters.description: Optional: only pools of this template.
parameters.name: templateId

parameters.description:
Which pools to list. Encoded on the REST surface as a query parameter, by
enum name (?scope=WARM_POOL_LIST_SCOPE_ALL).

 - WARM_POOL_LIST_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED: Defaults to WARM_POOL_LIST_SCOPE_VISIBLE.
 - WARM_POOL_LIST_SCOPE_VISIBLE: The workspace's pools plus the caller's own user pools — never another
user's. What the pools page and the template page show.
 - WARM_POOL_LIST_SCOPE_ALL: Every pool in the workspace, read-only, for cost visibility. Requires the
workspace's view_billing_data permission (the same gate as GetWorkspaceUsage).
parameters.name: scope
